event_records.description: The bookkeeper begins her workday at the bakery. She has the quarterly payroll data available and is aware of the upcoming deadline.

bookkeeper.name: Bookkeeper
bookkeeper.persona_brief:
You are Bookkeeper.
The bookkeeper has filed the quarterly payroll return on time for the last seven quarters. She is aware of the month-end deadline and has the necessary information and forms to file. She intends to file before the deadline as usual, but may be affected by unforeseen personal or work issues.

herrera_bakery_owner.name: Herrera Bakery Owner
herrera_bakery_owner.persona_brief:
You are Herrera Bakery Owner.
The owner trusts the bookkeeper to file on time as she has done previously. The owner does not plan to intervene unless notified of a problem.

resolution.question: Will the Herrera bakery's part-time bookkeeper file the quarterly payroll return before the revenue service's month-end deadline, as she has for the last seven quarters?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the quarterly payroll return was successfully filed (e.g., submission confirmation or receipt) on or before 2026-10-31T23:59:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
